documents.title: Document management - Portable document format - Part 2: PDF 2.0
documents.acquisition_source: PDF Association sponsored local copy supplied to workspace
documents.errata_resolution_set_applied: EC3 sponsored copy; observed 2020 correction notes in local text for PubSec tables
derived_notes: PubSec recipient envelopes carry a seed and, in document-level recipient lists, permission bytes.
SubFilter adbe.pkcs7.s3 and adbe.pkcs7.s4 use encryption dictionary /Recipients; adbe.pkcs7.s5 uses crypt-filter recipient locations.
File-key derivation for PubSec hashes seed, recipient CMS byte strings in order, and metadata marker where specified.
Crypt-filter /CFM values prior to ISO/TS 32003 are None, V2, AESV2, AESV3; unknown values must not silently downgrade.

documents.title: Document management - Portable document format - Extensions to ISO 32000-2 - Part 3: Use of AES-GCM in PDF 2.0
documents.acquisition_source: PDF Association sponsored local copy supplied to workspace
documents.errata_resolution_set_applied: 2023 sponsored copy; no separate local errata file supplied
derived_notes: Adds encryption dictionary /V 6 and Standard handler /R 7 behavior.
AESV4 uses a 32-byte crypt-filter key, 12-byte IV, ciphertext, 16-byte authentication tag, nil AAD, and no padding.
The same crypt-filter key may protect many objects, but IV reuse under that key is prohibited.

documents.title: Document management - Portable document format - Extensions to ISO 32000-2 - Part 4: Integrity protection in encrypted PDF 2.0 documents
documents.acquisition_source: PDF Association sponsored local copy supplied to workspace
documents.errata_resolution_set_applied: 2024 sponsored copy; no separate local errata file supplied
derived_notes: Adds permission-bit semantics that can require PDF MAC tokens in encrypted revisions.
Trailer /AuthCode and KDFSalt parsing/reporting are required before claiming document-level integrity.
AES-GCM object authentication is separate from PDF MAC document-level integrity validation.
